name: media-automation-lark
input_files: file-backed fixture: user-provided feeds, URLs, local materials, and optional metrics source files
output_contract: Previewable Markdown, JSON backups, HTML dashboards, and optional Feishu/Lark records; writes are explicit and dry-run capable.
rollback_boundary: Only generated local output and explicitly selected Feishu/Lark targets may be changed; source files are read-only unless the user requests an import.
network_policy: HTTPS requests are limited by the runtime URL safety checks and configured search backends; credentials come from environment variables.
package_scope: The installable package contains runtime Skill files only. Source-repository validation evidence lives under evals/ (including evals/output/) and reports/skill-evidence/; generated output/, output_panel/, hyperframes/, mp4/, and media/ directories are also excluded from GitHub CLI installs and the versioned archive.
